_README: The `props` variant set, option `reserve`. Same four keys as the base manifest,
different PNGs - art_boot lays this over the base, so no drawing code knows it
exists. Option 0 (the shipped default) has no file and needs none.
Pivots and scales are COPIED FROM THE BASE and must stay copied: every design in
a set is derived at the same STAGE_H, so they share a pivot by construction, and a
variant that invented its own would spin about a different point than the prop it
